<b>Swamp Squits</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are plentiful pests with sharp proboscises and bellies full of bile.<ref>Swamp Squit [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Plentiful pest with a sharp proboscis and a belly full of bile."</i></ref> Their species is a member of the [[Squits|Squit]] family.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Swamp Squits hover around in a small area or hang on walls when not aggressive.<br>
When a Swamp Squit spots Hornet, it follows her while maintaining distance, then attacks by darting towards her. It bounces back slightly if it hits a wall while lunging.

When a Swamp Squit dies, it pauses in the air whilst building up toward bursting, and then leaves behind a green explosion that deals {{Damage|2}}. Other Swamp Squits and [[Miremite]]s are instantly killed when caught in this explosion, triggering their explosions as well.

Swamp Squits deal {{Damage|1}} with their lunge and upon contact.

Dead Swamp Squits respawn after 5 seconds if Hornet is far away enough from their chosen respawn point or after Hornet re-enters the room.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Survive in smog...
* Choke on bile...
* Feed... or starve...
* Resist the rot...
}}

== Location ==
Swamp Squits can be found all over [[Bilewater]], with each room having several predetermined locations that a Swamp Squit can choose to spawn at. Only a certain number of Swamp Squits can exist in the room at a time.

==Trivia==
* Swamp Squits have the same Needolin dialogue as the [[Miremite]] and [[Spit Squit]].
* Swamp Squits share a similar name and visual design as the [[Squit]]s from <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>.
** Interestingly, this name similarity is not preserved in all translations of the game, perhaps due to different teams translating both games.
